name: browser-lab
description: A power toolkit for the whole web: live browser automation, deep frontend debugging, and network disassembly (browser-lab skill) plus web search, scraping, crawling, and structured data extraction at scale (web-harvest skill). Two orchestration skills route every task across Playwright, Chrome DevTools, mitmproxy, Firecrawl, Exa, Tavily, Bright Data, and Apify.
